description: Append-only claim event log emitted by cynic agent claim/release/status/identify/register. One JSON line per event, stored in data_system/vault/captures/agent-claims-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Every line must carry this exact value.

event.description: Event type. Distinguishes kernel-granted vs local-fallback operations for observability.

target.description: Claimed target path or crate. '*' for agent-level operations (identify, register, status).

detail.description: Event-specific payload. Contents depend on event type.
